mapper.select: SELECT * FROM im_conversation WHERE min_user_id = #{minUserId} AND max_user_id = #{maxUserId} AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1

SELECT c.conversation_id, CASE WHEN c.min_user_id = #{userId} THEN c.max_user_id ELSE c.min_user_id END AS target_id, IFNULL(u.nick_name, u.user_name) AS target_name, u.avatar AS target_avatar, c.last_msg_content, c.last_msg_time, CASE WHEN c.min_user_id = #{userId} THEN c.unread_count_a ELSE c.unread_count_b END AS unread_count FROM im_conversation c INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = (CASE WHEN c.min_user_id = #{userId} THEN c.max_user_id ELSE c.min_user_id END) AND u.del_flag = '0' WHERE (c.min_user_id = #{userId} OR c.max_user_id = #{userId}) AND c.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY c.last_msg_time DESC, c.conversation_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE im_conversation SET unread_count_a = CASE WHEN min_user_id = #{receiverId} THEN unread_count_a + 1 ELSE unread_count_a END, unread_count_b = CASE WHEN max_user_id = #{receiverId} THEN unread_count_b + 1 ELSE unread_count_b END WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}

UPDATE im_conversation SET unread_count_a = CASE WHEN min_user_id = #{userId} THEN 0 ELSE unread_count_a END, unread_count_b = CASE WHEN max_user_id = #{userId} THEN 0 ELSE unread_count_b END WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN min_user_id = #{userId} THEN unread_count_a ELSE unread_count_b END ), 0) FROM im_conversation WHERE (min_user_id = #{userId} OR max_user_id = #{userId}) AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT user_id AS userId, IFNULL(nick_name, user_name) AS nickName, user_name AS userName, avatar AS avatar FROM sys_user WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '0' AND user_id != #{userId} ORDER BY user_id ASC
